$comment: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (sub-shape of attestation:recovery-approval's evidence_json.summary_metric). Category A. Vote-child of governance-action:recovery-request. Shamir share material is NOT carried here — it travels off-chain via libp2p direct message gated by this attestation (see spec §5).
title: RecoveryApprovalAttestationMetadata
description: Per-subtype metadata for attestation:recovery-approval (vote-child of governance-action:recovery-request). Carries social-threshold approval only; cryptographic share material is decoupled off-DHT per spec §5.

share_commitment_hash.description: Optional hash-commitment to the Shamir share the custodian will deliver off-chain. Allows the recovery agent to verify share authenticity without the share material being on the DHT.
